what: The file formats you will meet
title: Single-cell data from GEO
text: GEO single-cell submissions heterogeneous. common formats: 10x Matrix Market triplet — three files per sample: sparse matrix.mtx[.gz], barcodes.tsv[.gz] (cell IDs), features.tsv[.gz]/genes.tsv[.gz] (gene IDs). three must read together; missing file makes sample unreadable. 10x HDF5 (.h5) — CellRanger filtered/raw feature-barcode matrix single HDF5 file. title: GEOquery 2.81.32
text: Downloads now retry connection fails, server returns retryable status. NCBI refuses connections load, surfaces curl transport error HTTP response — case httr2 retry unless asked. cause intermittent connect server [www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov] failures aborted ~65ms second attempt.

title: GEOquery 2.81.32
text: geoToSRA() resolves GEO Series Sample (GSE/GSM) underlying Sequence Read Archive accessions — returning tidy data.frame geo_accession, srp, srx, srr, srs (study/experiment/run/sample) cross-referencing NCBI Entrez (gds → sra). accession-linking bridge raw sequencing data; downloads sequence files. See ADR-0008 (#219). searchGEO() now uses batched JSON esummary backend (esummary db=gds&retmode=json&version=2.0) instead fetching string-parsing one text record time. faster large result sets returns structured, stably-named columns: Accession, Title, Summary, Organism, Type, GPL, n_samples, PDAT, suppFile, FTPLink, SeriesTitle, entryType, ID. Adds lightweight jsonlite dependency (#223).

title: GEOquery 2.81.32
text: Downloaded cached files can now integrity-checked expected MD5. downloadFile() gains opt-md5= argument; mismatch emits structured geoquery_checksum_mismatch warning (advisory, error) corrupt file cached. Foundational raw-file resolver fetch receipt (#222).

title: GEOquery 2.81.31 (2026-07-18)
text: GDS2MA() deprecated now warns; removed future release. limma::MAList return type superseded GDS2eSet()’s ExpressionSet (coercible SummarizedExperiment downstream structures). limma moves Imports Suggests accordingly, longer installed GEOquery; GDS2MA() errors clear message limma absent (#217).

title: GEOquery 2.81.30 (2026-07-18)
text: Dropped rvest stringr dependencies (user-facing change). GEO download-page link parsing now uses xml2 (already dependency) remaining string helpers use base R; extracted .extractGeoDownloadLinks() covered new offline test (#216).

title: GEOquery 2.81.29 (2026-07-18)

title: GEOquery 2.81.28 (2026-07-17)
text: Restructured vignettes coherent six-document set, installed package: Getting started, Understanding GEO data formats, Finding downloading data (new — covers searchGEO(), download control, persistent caching/reproducibility, reviewer-token access), RNA-seq quantifications, Single-cell data GEO, GEO downstream analysis. -depth articles now built vignettes (previously website-) available offline Bioconductor landing page. Vignette code precompiled *.qmd.orig sources (see dev/precompute-vignettes.R) shows real GEO output package/CI builds make network calls.

title: GEOquery 2.81.27 (2026-07-17)
text: getGEOSingleCell() now attaches sample’s GEO metadata — parsed characteristics_* fields (age, sex, genotype, tissue, treatment, …), title, source name — returned object’s colData, broadcast across sample’s cells, controlled new addSampleMeta argument (default TRUE). columns prefixed sample. avoid clashing importer’s colData, survive combining across samples (= "platform" / = ""), now reconciles differing colData columns (union, NA-filled). metadata comes Series Matrix pData (GSE) GSM SOFT record (lone GSM); whole-study files GSM get nothing. Previously single-cell matrices carried phenotype information (#210, split #158).

title: GEOquery 2.81.26 (2026-07-17)
text: getGEO() getGEOfile() gain token argument fetching private/embargoed GEO records NCBI GEO reviewer access token (obtained “Reviewer access” link private GSE’s page). private records published GEO FTP tree, token forces SOFT (acc.cgi) download path appends token request; GSE returns GSE S4 object (GSEMatrix = FALSE) rather SummarizedExperiment. See ADR-0007 (#154).

title: GEOquery 2.81.25 (2026-07-17)
text: Series Matrix records whose ID_REF repeats feature identifier (common IDs gene symbols, e.g. GSE136400 CXXC1 twice) longer fail duplicate row.names: ... AnnotatedDataFrame 'initialize' update varMetadata. Duplicate feature IDs now made unique make.unique(), mirroring existing guard GDS2eSet() (#98). getGEO(filename=) metadata-SOFT file — truncated output getGEOfile(amount = "quick") "brief", contains ^SAMPLE/^PLATFORM entities — now returns GSE object empty sample/platform lists instead erroring invalid 'n' argument / NA/NaN argument (#14). getGSEDataTables() now always returns list data.frames, including Series carries exactly one <Data-Table> (previously single-table Series GSE98638 mis-simplified character matrix). makes series-level annotation tables — e.g. single-cell study’s per-cell “Listing Individual Cells” table — reliably accessible (#80).

title: GEOquery 2.81.25 (2026-07-17)
text: getGEO() gains encoding argument ("unknown" (default), "UTF-8", "Latin-1") occasional non-UTF-8 GEO record. sets character encoding used underlying data.table::fread() reads duration call; override available globally via options(GEOquery.encoding = ...) (#148).

title: GEOquery 2.81.24 (2026-07-17)
text: extractFilenameFromDownloadURL() — therefore getRNASeqQuantGenomeInfo() — longer errors handed empty (zero-length) URL, happens Series NCBI-computed RNA-seq annotation link. now returns NULL documented instead raising httr2::url_parse() error (#207).

title: GEOquery 2.81.24 (2026-07-17)
text: Added deterministic, network-free unit tests pure helper functions RNA-seq (R/rnaseq.R), Entrez-search (R/searchGEO.R), SOFT-parsing (R/parseGEO.R), supplemental-file, GDS-conversion, file-open code paths, raising baseline coverage (#207). New skip_if_geo_offline() test helper (mirroring BiocPkgTools’ skip_if_bioc_offline()) probes NCBI GEO reachability network-dependent tests run host skip cleanly (#207, #169).

title: GEOquery 2.81.23 (2026-06-16)
text: Seurat interoperability single-cell data (optional; Seurat Suggests). readGEOSingleCell() now reads .rds supplementary files containing Seurat SingleCellExperiment object (detected class; Seurat coerced SingleCellExperiment), .rds now loadable single-cell format. readGEOSingleCell() getGEOSingleCell() gain = "Seurat" return Seurat objects (coerced output boundary). SingleCellExperiment remains internal representation; see ADR-0006 (#195, #196, #197).

title: GEOquery 2.81.22 (2026-06-14)
text: geoSingleCellManifest() getGEOSingleCell() now handle common case Series ships GSE..._RAW.tar series level per-sample files live sample’s GSM suppl directory (e.g. GSE132771). series level loadable single-cell units, manifest falls back enumerating Series’ samples (via getGEO()) inventorying GSM suppl directory. functions also accept GSM accession directly (getGEOSingleCell("GSM3891612")), geoSingleCellManifest() gains samples argument restrict specific GSMs without enumerating whole Series. Unit files downloaded URL, readers work whether data lives series sample level (#190). getGEOSingleCell() gains argument — one "sample" (default; named list one SingleCellExperiment per sample), "platform" (named list keyed platform/GPL, platform’s samples combined), "" (single combined object) — replacing previous combine flag. GEO Series can span multiple platforms (e.g. GSE132771 mixes mouse human), platform natural feature-compatibility boundary, = "platform" right way combine multi-platform study; return shape determined argument, data. geoSingleCellManifest() now reports platform (GPL) column per sample, geoSingleCellUnits() treats whole-study single file unit study’s several .h5ad files longer merged one bogus unit. Gzipped single-file formats (.h5ad.gz, .h5.gz) recognized transparently decompressed reading. loom reported flagged loadable, built-reader (.rds/Seurat support follows 2.81.23) (#190).

title: GEOquery 2.81.22 (2026-06-14)
text: Combining single-cell samples (getGEOSingleCell(= "platform"|"")) longer fails cryptic cbind error ('mcols' ... match subscript contains invalid names) Series’ samples heterogeneous feature annotation — common single-cell studies (e.g. GSE132771 mixes 10x CellRanger v2 genes.tsv v3 features.tsv, giving different rowData columns). Samples restricted shared features given one canonical rowData binding; share features (single combined object impossible) clear, actionable error raised (#190).

title: GEOquery 2.81.21 (2026-06-13)
text: getGEO() now returns SummarizedExperiment objects default GSE Series Matrix records (previously ExpressionSet). Update downstream code exprs()/pData()/fData() assay()/colData()/rowData(), pass returnType = "ExpressionSet" keep old behavior. Existing results can also converted as_SummarizedExperiment(). SOFT-format results (GDS/GPL/GSM/GSE S4 objects) unaffected. See ADR-0002 ADR-0005 (#168).

title: GEOquery 2.81.21 (2026-06-13)
text: Optional persistent download cache backed BiocFileCache. Set options(GEOquery.cache = TRUE) downloads keyed URL reused across sessions (location defaults tools::R_user_dir("GEOquery", "cache"), overridable via options(GEOquery.cache.path = ...)). New geoCache() clearGEOCache() expose clear . default now, preserving historical destdir behavior (#171). New readGEOSingleCell() getGEOSingleCell() read GEO single-cell supplementary data SingleCellExperiment objects: 10x Matrix Market 10x HDF5 via TENxIO, AnnData .h5ad via anndataR (optional Suggests). getGEOSingleCell() returns named list per-sample objects (combine care) reports units loads skips. loom, files inside _RAW.tar, idiosyncratic layouts intentionally scope — use geoSingleCellManifest() + readGEOSingleCell() (#158, #190). New geoSingleCellManifest() inventories GSE’s supplementary files classifies single-cell format (10x Matrix Market triplet, 10x HDF5, AnnData h5ad, loom, Seurat rds, tar), grouping GSM sample — can see single-cell study contains downloading. geoSingleCellUnits() collapses manifest loadable units (per sample + format) flags completeness (e.g. incomplete 10x triplet). Steps toward single-cell readers (ADR-0004) (#158, #188, #189). getGEO() gains returnType argument. returnType = "SummarizedExperiment", GSE Series Matrix results returned SummarizedExperiment objects instead ExpressionSet. default remains "ExpressionSet" now (one-time notice) switch "SummarizedExperiment" future release. new exported as_SummarizedExperiment() coerces existing ExpressionSet result without re-downloading. See ADR-0002 (#168). Downloads now stream disk instead buffering entire response memory, retry transient HTTP errors, honor configurable GEOquery.download.timeout option (default 300 seconds) — replacing previous enforced 120-second floor ignored lower user timeouts. Failures raise typed geoquery_download_error carrying URL HTTP status. getDirListing() now uses httr2 layer (#147, #173). GEOquery now raises typed error conditions — geoquery_error subclasses (geoquery_private_accession, geoquery_download_error, geoquery_parse_error, geoquery_bad_accession) — failures can handled programmatically tryCatch() (#170, #184, #186). getGEOSuppFiles() gains quiet argument (defaulting GEOquery.quiet option, FALSE) suppress informational messages “supplemental files found” “Using locally cached version” (#68, #182).

title: GEOquery 2.81.21 (2026-06-13)
text: S4 class accessor documentation filled : GEOData accessors (Meta, Table, Columns, dataTable, Accession, GSMList, GPLList) now real descriptions, return values, examples, class pages longer imply constructing objects new() — returned getGEO() (#103, #192). Documentation reorganized narrative pkgdown articles — Understanding GEO data formats, RNA-seq quantifications, Single-cell data GEO, GEO downstream analysis — cover (entity types, file formats) downstream workflows links Bioconductor packages. package vignette now concise quick-start indexes ; articles render pkgdown site excluded R CMD check (#156, #191). package DESCRIPTION biocViews now describe GEOquery’s actual scope (microarray, RNA-seq, single-cell; GEO Series Matrix files parsed ExpressionSet default) instead microarray-(#71, #181).

title: GEOquery 2.81.21 (2026-06-13)
text: Supplemental-file URLs now built small url_join() helper instead file.path(), mangled https:// https:/ produced double slashes. Affects getGEOSuppFiles(fetch_files = FALSE) getGEOSeriesFileListing() (#131, #178). GDS2eSet() longer fails GDS NA (empty) value ID_REF column (e.g. GDS3666). values replaced usable feature name instead producing “row names contain missing values” (#21, #177). getGEO() now fails clear message accession private, embargoed, yet public (NCBI returns HTML page) instead mis-parsing , older versions, looping. findFirstEntity() also hardened multi-line edge case error unbounded reads (#58, #176). getGEO(parseCharacteristics = FALSE) now actually skips characteristics parsing. flag accepted top level dropped reaching parseGSEMatrix(); now threaded getAndParseGSEMatrices() parseGEO() (#60, #175). Fixed error parsing GSE matrix files malformed empty lines sample metadata (e.g., GSE425). Sample lines now extracted directly using pattern matching avoid issues irregular file formatting (#162).
